declaration.population: all 288 venue-resolved markets/day; 2592 per arm/timing; same flat initial state and fixed tape
declaration.selection: all nine previously prepared consumed days; fixed guards trained on eight; exploratory in-sample
declaration.uniform10: cap new inventory-adding orders at 10 shares per order; retain all original reduction sizing and guards
declaration.reserved10: size inventory-adding orders to max(0,10 - signed known net - all same-side known remaining reservations); recheck at submission
declaration.adding: side sign times known net >= 0; orders currently reducing are unchanged even if they could cross zero
declaration.common_new_arm_mechanics: keep same-price guard-eligible existing adding order if its known remainder fits desired size and applicable room; no upsize while it remains eligible; current and pending orders remain reserved until terminal knowledge
declaration.allocation: existing orders reserve first, then new desired orders in engine lane order 0,1,2,3; no netting opposite-side reservations; quantity floored to 0.01 and existing 1-share/1-USDT checks
limitations: not a global hard 10-share cap: unchanged reducing orders and delayed fills can cross zero
new-arm versus baseline includes shared remaining-quantity retention; reserved versus uniform isolates the budget rule
uniform control fixes order cap, not realized turnover; no ex-post activity matching or tuning
historical tape has no own market impact or full OMS; no independent validation claim
declaration.baseline_reuse: fresh first full date at J/X plus eight-market smoke; other main baselines copied from verified prior artifacts with hashes
controls: FIFO matched/residual accounting and full-path inventory controls
metrics: FIFO matched-trade PnL and residual PnL
declaration.attribution: FIFO matched PnL includes price drift between fills and is not pure spread; squared inventory is a risk proxy, not calibrated outcome variance

null.design: 2000 paired shared UTC-day sign flips with sign-invariant RMS max-T; 2000 paired day bootstrap draws
null.family: reserved versus baseline, uniform versus baseline, reserved versus uniform; J/X x settlement/+1s/inventory-square = 18

generations.interpretation: identification bounds, not confidence intervals; repeated identical creation timestamps lack unique order IDs
